text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

Both you and the successful candidate are men, and so was the whole panel. An all-male panel is a governance weakness and may matter for other candidates, but it gives you no grounds to argue you lost out because of your sex. Raising it would likely read as grasping and undermine your stronger points.

Those stronger points are real: a credentials gap on paper, a vague justification ("broad experience of regulatory affairs"), and a two-week silence on your written request. Chase that request formally in writing, citing the date you asked. Ask specifically what criteria were scored and how. If the answer reveals criteria invented or reweighted after shortlisting, that's your actual issue.
